title: A board's header pins: on each pin's tip, and a pad on the board's face
why: A 30 x 20 mm board, 1.6 mm thick, with two 0.64 mm square header pins 8 mm tall at (-7.5, 5) and (-5, 5): 25% and 33% across, 25% down the picture. A wire (or a Dupont plug) goes on the tip, z = 9.6, facing up. A pad at 75% across, 75% down has nothing on it: its wire ends on the board's top, z = 1.6, at (7.5, -5).
